generation.retry_rule: Stop at first failed beat; at most one documented prompt/guide correction, never an unchanged blind retry.

beats.action: James leaves the console, crosses the open doorway and disappears into opaque blowing snow; Kate remains inside. Finish with James absent from view.
acceptance: James is absent at the end
Kate does not leave with him

beats.action: Kate looks through the snow-filled doorway and calls for James. No James in foreground, background, reflections or screen images.

dialogue.text: James! No! The ice is humming right now.

acceptance: Speech and lip sync remain intelligible

beats.action: Kate lifts the portable radio and secures its strap, then turns toward the exit with resolve. James remains missing.

dialogue.text: He is gone, but the signal found him. I must follow.

acceptance: Ends on a new committed action, not another reaction close-up

promotion_gate: User reviews the assembled opening plus three beats with audio; only then integrate or render a full episode.
